# Ontology-Native Software Engineering

> An independent, non-commercial technical research project exploring how ontologies could guide software design, implementation, verification, and evolution.

The canonical site is __SITE_URL__. Ontology-Native Software Engineering explores an evolving technical hypothesis about ontology-native software engineering, subject to experimentation and technical validation.

## Primary content

- [Ontology-Native Software Engineering](__SITE_URL__): The human-readable homepage with the research motivation, hypothesis, scenarios, browser-only self-assessment, experimental directions, and research topics.
- [Ontology-Native Software Engineering in Markdown](__SITE_URL__index.html.md): A faithful text version of the homepage for AI agents and other text-first clients.
